name: East Ridge
approach: From the Reflection Lakes trailhead, follow the maintained Pinnacle Saddle Trail 1.3 mi (~1,000-1,050 ft gain) to the Pinnacle-Plummer saddle. From the saddle, continue on the unmaintained boot path east/behind Pinnacle toward Castle Peak to reach the Castle-Pinnacle col; the east ridge of Pinnacle rises directly from this col. Trip reports cite roughly 2-3 hours and about 1,500 ft of gain for this approach segment.
